title: Sales & Marketing Executive
description:
* **Sales & Marketing Executive – 1**
* **Location: Kolkate, West Bengal**
* **Experience: 2–5 Years**
* **Salary: ₹18,000–₹25,000 per month**
* **Qualification: Graduate in Marketing, Commerce, or a related field preferred. Candidates with relevant sales experience may also apply.**
* **Note: We are looking for experienced candidates only, preferably from HVAC & Cleanroom equipments industry. Freshers are generally not preferred.**
* **Key Responsibilities:**
* Identify and develop new business opportunities in HVAC, cleanroom equipment, and industrial project markets.
* Generate business enquiries and leads from pharmaceutical companies, hospitals, food processing industries, factories, and other commercial establishments.
* Promote the company's HVAC products, cleanroom solutions, and turnkey project services to potential customers.
* Conduct client visits, meetings, presentations, and follow-ups to develop business relationships.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with architects, consultants, contractors, builders, project managers, and industrial clients.
* Understand customer requirements and coordinate with the technical team to suggest suitable products and solutions.
* Prepare quotations, proposals, and commercial offers in coordination with the sales and technical departments.
* Follow up on enquiries, quotations, negotiations, purchase orders, and pending business opportunities.
* Conduct market research to identify new customers, competitors, industry trends, and business opportunities in the assigned territory.
* Achieve monthly sales targets and contribute to business growth in Kolkata and Raipur.
* Maintain customer databases, sales reports, enquiry records, and follow-up schedules.
* Coordinate with internal departments for order processing, project execution, delivery, and customer support.
* Support promotional activities, exhibitions, client networking, and other business development initiatives.
* **Preferred Skills:**
* Good communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Knowledge of B2B sales, lead generation, and customer relationship management.
* Ability to develop new markets and independently manage customer follow-ups.
* Willingness to travel locally for client meetings and business development.
* Experience in HVAC, engineering products, construction, industrial equipment, or project sales will be an advantage.

**Company: Airbox Concepts Pvt. Ltd.**

**Head Office: Plot No. 3, 4 & 5, Amar Nagar Road, Near Mohite Industrial Estate, Hingna MIDC, Nagpur – 440016, Maharashtra, India.**

**Contact Person: Ajinkya Dhakate**

**Designation: HR & Administration Head**

**Mobile: 9834161451**

**Airbox Concepts Pvt. Ltd.**

Pay: ₹18,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Work Location: On the road
